_authoring.purpose: Instructions for the player character speaking about her own experience.
_authoring.player_controls: Format and delivery of private player self-comments.
_authoring.perspective: The affected player speaks; no nearby character replies in this private response.
_authoring.boundary: Does not control all NPC dialogue or choose gameplay actions.

_help: Edit template text or replace a template with a string array. Keep the documented placeholders. Use MCM Reload Narration JSON after saving.

_authoring.intent: Keep the affected player's private reaction to one first-person spoken line, without other speakers.

player_instructions.template:
为 {actor} 写一篇简短的、非图形的口头自我评论。
说话者是经历所提供情况的人，而不是观察者。
仅返回一个纯文本第一人称行。没有演讲者标签、舞台指示，
对话伙伴、标记或其他人的回复。不要发明效果。
